decisions.assertion: Axes composition/rank/order and optional dimensions
decisions.reason: 2-5 rank, 2-3 spatial axes, optional time and channel/null/custom slot, order corresponding to the arrays, and SHOULD zyx are explicit. Names alone cannot identify semantic axes.

decisions.assertion: Absent dimensions versus length-one dimensions; supported navigation range
decisions.reason: Both reports discuss axis-driven relevance, but neither explicitly distinguishes absent time/channel/z from present singleton axes or supplies an exact supported navigation range. This is a coverage omission, not a claim that such fixtures were executed.

decisions.assertion: Missing/null/custom type and unit tolerance
decisions.reason: Recommended type/unit fields can be missing in contexts that remain conforming; however multiscales requires 2 or 3 entries of type:space. Blanket MUST-tolerate-any-missing/unknown type ignores that more specific constraint. The permitted null/custom extra axis is not proof that every spatial axis may be null.

decisions.assertion: Position-only semantic classification or innermost-plane rule
decisions.reason: The source requires metadata identity; recommended zyx does not force arbitrary three-space axes into a universal plane selection. Generic explicitly untyped controls can be a product policy, but guessing semantic t/c/z from position is not a source-derived obligation.

decisions.assertion: Space/time units vocabulary; no channel-unit list
decisions.reason: Only space/time lists are supplied. This does not prohibit meaningful channel/custom metadata or justify a universal assertion that channel scale can never matter.

decisions.assertion: omero optional; channels/color/window field constraints
decisions.reason: Required data fields, RGB six-hex format, and window min/max/start/end meaning match. Reader initialization details need interpretation beyond field presence.

decisions.assertion: omero active/coefficient/family/inverted/label/rdefs/defaultT/defaultZ/model example siblings
decisions.reason: The siblings occur in the example; required-field prose does not require them. Best-effort initialization is a sensible proposal, not proof of actual reader behavior.

decisions.assertion: omero channel length matching occurs as example comment
decisions.reason: The length comment exists; the required-field prose states no separate length MUST. Explicit overlap degradation is a proposed policy.

decisions.assertion: No normative color/window semantics beyond field presence
decisions.reason: RGB format and meanings of min/max/start/end are expressly stated. No gamma/family registry or explicit out-of-dtype-range rule is supplied, which is a narrower supported absence.

decisions.assertion: Reader MUST apply particular initial contrast limits/colors; out-of-dtype-range/start>end automatically malformed
decisions.reason: Presence/format constraints do not prove the proposed initial rendering policy or dtype-range rejection. Malformed color not satisfying six hex digits is supported; extending malformed status to unspecified window policies conflates specification silence and input invalidity.

decisions.assertion: Absent omero leaves all rendering state with no embedded defaults
decisions.reason: For intensity-channel defaults the source supplies no alternative omero block. A blanket all-rendering/no-embedded-display-defaults claim overlooks image-label colors and the reader SHOULD display them even if omero is absent.

decisions.assertion: General transforms sequential; identity/translation/scale and binary paths
decisions.reason: Vocabulary, sequential list order and vector/path alternatives are explicit. Image transform lists have narrower types than this general vocabulary.

decisions.assertion: Dataset transform restrictions and fallback factors
decisions.reason: Exactly one scale, at most one translation after scale, matching vector length, physical/time scale or relative fallback, and default 1 without downsampling are explicit.

decisions.assertion: Global transforms after dataset transforms; outer-after-inner composition
decisions.reason: This rule applies to all supplied transform vectors, not just the time axis example. Correct function notation within each list is translation after scale.

decisions.assertion: Scale∘translate formula for a scale-before-translation list
decisions.reason: Conventional right-to-left function composition makes scale∘translate apply translation first. R012 also says listed order, creating internal inconsistency. Correct per-level mapping is s*p+t, then global S*(s*p+t)+T.

decisions.assertion: Worked 5D example values and voxel arithmetic
decisions.reason: Given scales [1,1,.5,.5,.5], [1,1,1,1,1], [1,1,2,2,2] and global [.1,1,1,1,1], the reported .1 ms/.5 micrometer level-zero voxel sizes are correct. This zero-translation example does not test offsets or reversed scale/translation order.

decisions.assertion: Worked calibration is a normative example
decisions.reason: Examples are informative. R011 explicitly corrects this terminology; R012 retains it.

decisions.assertion: Unknown units/calibration and channel-never-physical claim
decisions.reason: Avoid inventing units; disclose unknown calibration. Unit absence alone does not change every provided scale into a proved relative factor. Channel index display is a sensible choice, but the universal never-meaningful-scale statement lacks source support.

decisions.assertion: Origin lacks explicit anchoring; image-group-frame assumption
decisions.reason: No explicit origin anchoring beyond coordinate spaces/offset is supplied. Declaring an image-frame assumption is valid; it is not a source guarantee.

decisions.assertion: Binary transform encoding gaps and vector-length counterevidence
decisions.reason: Binary dtype/byte order/storage encoding are underspecified, but vector dimensionality and multiscale vector-length constraints are supplied. No dtype/shape rule whatsoever is too broad if it discards those constraints. Unsupported handling is a valid capability limit.

decisions.assertion: No multi-axis global worked example; composition beyond time unresolved
decisions.reason: Example absence is supported. General multi-axis composition is specified by the same sequential/global-after rules; missing example is not grounds to dismiss that rule as unresolved.

decisions.assertion: Concrete translation-sensitive calibration validation
decisions.reason: Both preserve valid UNEXECUTED translation proposals, but neither gives a nonzero-offset worked expectation that could expose reversal/omission. No fixture or execution is required to credit a valid proposal; assigned full facet needs a concrete check.

decisions.assertion: Labels hierarchy, labels paths, arbitrary names and intermediate folders
decisions.reason: Container declaration/list/path discovery and arbitrary names are supported. Intermediate groups may exist and MUST NOT carry metadata.

decisions.assertion: All labels SHOULD be listed; unlisted scan policy
decisions.reason: SHOULD listing permits reasoned exceptions. Additional scan/discovery policy is a product choice and cannot become format invalidity solely from being unlisted.

decisions.assertion: Labels multiscales, same source level count and eight integer dtypes
decisions.reason: Exact dtype set and count requirement match. Integer type admission does not itself establish lossless host-number representation.

decisions.assertion: Label same-coordinate-system relation versus usually dimensions/transforms
decisions.reason: Usually modifies equal dimensions/transformations, not the preceding same-coordinate-system relationship. Rephrasing this as usually same system weakens the association/registration premise.

decisions.assertion: Same-or-one label dimensions and source force
decisions.reason: Lowercase should remains recommended normative language; overview placement alone is not an exception. It is a SHOULD, not a geometric equality MUST. The report may propose explicit broadcast checks.

decisions.assertion: Same-index levels, broadcast and own transforms with divergence warning
decisions.reason: Reasonable rendering policy if source identity and physical mapping are resolved. Equal counts do not independently prove same-index geometry, and warning does not establish aligned overlay validity.

decisions.assertion: Label-versus-parent transform precedence wholly unspecified
decisions.reason: There is no literal precedence sentence. A label must implement its own multiscales coordinate mapping, and that mapping cannot be silently replaced by the parent. Reports preserve an own-transform verification policy, but overstate uncertainty if they dismiss this requirement.

decisions.assertion: image-label object and colors/version field force
decisions.reason: image-label SHOULD be present; it SHOULD contain colors and version. Values are MUST array/string when supplied. Treating keys as unconditional MUST merely because image-label exists is stronger than source.

decisions.assertion: Colors/properties key by integer label-value; rgba values/alpha
decisions.reason: Color/property entries identify labels by value, with rgba four integers 0..255 and alpha opacity. Array order is not categorical identity.

decisions.assertion: Reader SHOULD use specified colors; fallback palette/legend/property UI
decisions.reason: Color behavior is recommended, not universal mandatory styling. Fallback and property legend are product proposals; required legend/property UI is not necessary to the stated aligned-overlay acceptance.

decisions.assertion: Source.image relative path and ../../ default
decisions.reason: Source is optional, image key is optional; supplied image must be a relative path to a Zarr image group. Source metadata identifies original image, not an arbitrary cosmetic string.

decisions.assertion: Resolve associated source before overlay; provenance-only restriction
decisions.reason: R011 does not explicitly require relative-source identity resolution before overlay. R012 explicitly confines source.image to provenance and not overlay relocation, losing declared association when parent/default and explicit source differ. A conforming truthful unsupported result is acceptable; attaching by parent/shape without association validation is not established.

decisions.assertion: Sparse/large exact categorical IDs and resampling
decisions.reason: Both preserve categorical/integer/label-value/nearest-neighbor ideas. Neither covers uint64/int64 IDs above exact binary64 range or declares an exact supported ID range, nor tests scrambled sparse IDs. This is an assigned coverage omission, not an assertion that arbitrary interpolation is specified in the source.

decisions.assertion: No explicit interpolation/nearest/resampling algorithm
decisions.reason: No named algorithm is supplied. Identity-preserving categorical rendering is a sound consequence; nearest-neighbor is one defensible product policy, not the uniquely required algorithm.

decisions.assertion: Label worked colors/properties/source example
decisions.reason: Example values 0/1, rgba [0,0,128,128]/[0,128,0,128], alpha/color explanation, properties and relative source match. Example is informative.

decisions.assertion: Schema version-string vocabularies and accept-any-string policy
decisions.reason: No independent field vocabulary enumeration is supplied. A string must identify the schema/spec version, not merely be any string. Displaying unknown values is a product policy; a universal never-gate rule is not source-derived.

source_assertion_inventory.reason: 2-5 rank, 2-3 spatial axes, optional time and channel/null/custom slot, order corresponding to the arrays, and SHOULD zyx are explicit. Names alone cannot identify semantic axes.

source_assertion_inventory.assertion: Absent dimensions versus length-one dimensions; supported navigation range
source_assertion_inventory.reason: Both reports discuss axis-driven relevance, but neither explicitly distinguishes absent time/channel/z from present singleton axes or supplies an exact supported navigation range. This is a coverage omission, not a claim that such fixtures were executed.

source_assertion_inventory.assertion: Missing/null/custom type and unit tolerance
source_assertion_inventory.reason: Recommended type/unit fields can be missing in contexts that remain conforming; however multiscales requires 2 or 3 entries of type:space. Blanket MUST-tolerate-any-missing/unknown type ignores that more specific constraint. The permitted null/custom extra axis is not proof that every spatial axis may be null.

source_assertion_inventory.assertion: Position-only semantic classification or innermost-plane rule
source_assertion_inventory.reason: The source requires metadata identity; recommended zyx does not force arbitrary three-space axes into a universal plane selection. Generic explicitly untyped controls can be a product policy, but guessing semantic t/c/z from position is not a source-derived obligation.

source_assertion_inventory.assertion: Space/time units vocabulary; no channel-unit list
source_assertion_inventory.reason: Only space/time lists are supplied. This does not prohibit meaningful channel/custom metadata or justify a universal assertion that channel scale can never matter.

source_assertion_inventory.assertion: omero optional; channels/color/window field constraints
source_assertion_inventory.reason: Required data fields, RGB six-hex format, and window min/max/start/end meaning match. Reader initialization details need interpretation beyond field presence.

source_assertion_inventory.assertion: omero active/coefficient/family/inverted/label/rdefs/defaultT/defaultZ/model example siblings
source_assertion_inventory.reason: The siblings occur in the example; required-field prose does not require them. Best-effort initialization is a sensible proposal, not proof of actual reader behavior.

source_assertion_inventory.assertion: omero channel length matching occurs as example comment
source_assertion_inventory.reason: The length comment exists; the required-field prose states no separate length MUST. Explicit overlap degradation is a proposed policy.

source_assertion_inventory.assertion: No normative color/window semantics beyond field presence
source_assertion_inventory.reason: RGB format and meanings of min/max/start/end are expressly stated. No gamma/family registry or explicit out-of-dtype-range rule is supplied, which is a narrower supported absence.

source_assertion_inventory.assertion: Reader MUST apply particular initial contrast limits/colors; out-of-dtype-range/start>end automatically malformed
source_assertion_inventory.reason: Presence/format constraints do not prove the proposed initial rendering policy or dtype-range rejection. Malformed color not satisfying six hex digits is supported; extending malformed status to unspecified window policies conflates specification silence and input invalidity.

source_assertion_inventory.assertion: Absent omero leaves all rendering state with no embedded defaults
source_assertion_inventory.reason: For intensity-channel defaults the source supplies no alternative omero block. A blanket all-rendering/no-embedded-display-defaults claim overlooks image-label colors and the reader SHOULD display them even if omero is absent.

source_assertion_inventory.assertion: General transforms sequential; identity/translation/scale and binary paths
source_assertion_inventory.reason: Vocabulary, sequential list order and vector/path alternatives are explicit. Image transform lists have narrower types than this general vocabulary.

source_assertion_inventory.assertion: Dataset transform restrictions and fallback factors
source_assertion_inventory.reason: Exactly one scale, at most one translation after scale, matching vector length, physical/time scale or relative fallback, and default 1 without downsampling are explicit.

source_assertion_inventory.assertion: Global transforms after dataset transforms; outer-after-inner composition
source_assertion_inventory.reason: This rule applies to all supplied transform vectors, not just the time axis example. Correct function notation within each list is translation after scale.

source_assertion_inventory.assertion: Scale∘translate formula for a scale-before-translation list
source_assertion_inventory.reason: Conventional right-to-left function composition makes scale∘translate apply translation first. R012 also says listed order, creating internal inconsistency. Correct per-level mapping is s*p+t, then global S*(s*p+t)+T.

source_assertion_inventory.assertion: Worked 5D example values and voxel arithmetic
source_assertion_inventory.reason: Given scales [1,1,.5,.5,.5], [1,1,1,1,1], [1,1,2,2,2] and global [.1,1,1,1,1], the reported .1 ms/.5 micrometer level-zero voxel sizes are correct. This zero-translation example does not test offsets or reversed scale/translation order.

source_assertion_inventory.assertion: Worked calibration is a normative example
source_assertion_inventory.reason: Examples are informative. R011 explicitly corrects this terminology; R012 retains it.

source_assertion_inventory.assertion: Unknown units/calibration and channel-never-physical claim
source_assertion_inventory.reason: Avoid inventing units; disclose unknown calibration. Unit absence alone does not change every provided scale into a proved relative factor. Channel index display is a sensible choice, but the universal never-meaningful-scale statement lacks source support.

source_assertion_inventory.assertion: Origin lacks explicit anchoring; image-group-frame assumption
source_assertion_inventory.reason: No explicit origin anchoring beyond coordinate spaces/offset is supplied. Declaring an image-frame assumption is valid; it is not a source guarantee.

source_assertion_inventory.assertion: Binary transform encoding gaps and vector-length counterevidence
source_assertion_inventory.reason: Binary dtype/byte order/storage encoding are underspecified, but vector dimensionality and multiscale vector-length constraints are supplied. No dtype/shape rule whatsoever is too broad if it discards those constraints. Unsupported handling is a valid capability limit.

source_assertion_inventory.assertion: No multi-axis global worked example; composition beyond time unresolved
source_assertion_inventory.reason: Example absence is supported. General multi-axis composition is specified by the same sequential/global-after rules; missing example is not grounds to dismiss that rule as unresolved.

source_assertion_inventory.assertion: Concrete translation-sensitive calibration validation
source_assertion_inventory.reason: Both preserve valid UNEXECUTED translation proposals, but neither gives a nonzero-offset worked expectation that could expose reversal/omission. No fixture or execution is required to credit a valid proposal; assigned full facet needs a concrete check.

source_assertion_inventory.assertion: Labels hierarchy, labels paths, arbitrary names and intermediate folders
source_assertion_inventory.reason: Container declaration/list/path discovery and arbitrary names are supported. Intermediate groups may exist and MUST NOT carry metadata.

source_assertion_inventory.assertion: All labels SHOULD be listed; unlisted scan policy
source_assertion_inventory.reason: SHOULD listing permits reasoned exceptions. Additional scan/discovery policy is a product choice and cannot become format invalidity solely from being unlisted.

source_assertion_inventory.assertion: Labels multiscales, same source level count and eight integer dtypes
source_assertion_inventory.reason: Exact dtype set and count requirement match. Integer type admission does not itself establish lossless host-number representation.

source_assertion_inventory.assertion: Label same-coordinate-system relation versus usually dimensions/transforms
source_assertion_inventory.reason: Usually modifies equal dimensions/transformations, not the preceding same-coordinate-system relationship. Rephrasing this as usually same system weakens the association/registration premise.

source_assertion_inventory.assertion: Same-or-one label dimensions and source force
source_assertion_inventory.reason: Lowercase should remains recommended normative language; overview placement alone is not an exception. It is a SHOULD, not a geometric equality MUST. The report may propose explicit broadcast checks.

source_assertion_inventory.assertion: Same-index levels, broadcast and own transforms with divergence warning
source_assertion_inventory.reason: Reasonable rendering policy if source identity and physical mapping are resolved. Equal counts do not independently prove same-index geometry, and warning does not establish aligned overlay validity.

source_assertion_inventory.assertion: Label-versus-parent transform precedence wholly unspecified
source_assertion_inventory.reason: There is no literal precedence sentence. A label must implement its own multiscales coordinate mapping, and that mapping cannot be silently replaced by the parent. Reports preserve an own-transform verification policy, but overstate uncertainty if they dismiss this requirement.

source_assertion_inventory.assertion: image-label object and colors/version field force
source_assertion_inventory.reason: image-label SHOULD be present; it SHOULD contain colors and version. Values are MUST array/string when supplied. Treating keys as unconditional MUST merely because image-label exists is stronger than source.

source_assertion_inventory.assertion: Colors/properties key by integer label-value; rgba values/alpha
source_assertion_inventory.reason: Color/property entries identify labels by value, with rgba four integers 0..255 and alpha opacity. Array order is not categorical identity.

source_assertion_inventory.assertion: Reader SHOULD use specified colors; fallback palette/legend/property UI
source_assertion_inventory.reason: Color behavior is recommended, not universal mandatory styling. Fallback and property legend are product proposals; required legend/property UI is not necessary to the stated aligned-overlay acceptance.

source_assertion_inventory.assertion: Source.image relative path and ../../ default
source_assertion_inventory.reason: Source is optional, image key is optional; supplied image must be a relative path to a Zarr image group. Source metadata identifies original image, not an arbitrary cosmetic string.

source_assertion_inventory.assertion: Resolve associated source before overlay; provenance-only restriction
source_assertion_inventory.reason: R011 does not explicitly require relative-source identity resolution before overlay. R012 explicitly confines source.image to provenance and not overlay relocation, losing declared association when parent/default and explicit source differ. A conforming truthful unsupported result is acceptable; attaching by parent/shape without association validation is not established.

source_assertion_inventory.assertion: Sparse/large exact categorical IDs and resampling
source_assertion_inventory.reason: Both preserve categorical/integer/label-value/nearest-neighbor ideas. Neither covers uint64/int64 IDs above exact binary64 range or declares an exact supported ID range, nor tests scrambled sparse IDs. This is an assigned coverage omission, not an assertion that arbitrary interpolation is specified in the source.

source_assertion_inventory.assertion: No explicit interpolation/nearest/resampling algorithm
source_assertion_inventory.reason: No named algorithm is supplied. Identity-preserving categorical rendering is a sound consequence; nearest-neighbor is one defensible product policy, not the uniquely required algorithm.

source_assertion_inventory.assertion: Label worked colors/properties/source example
source_assertion_inventory.reason: Example values 0/1, rgba [0,0,128,128]/[0,128,0,128], alpha/color explanation, properties and relative source match. Example is informative.

source_assertion_inventory.assertion: Schema version-string vocabularies and accept-any-string policy
source_assertion_inventory.reason: No independent field vocabulary enumeration is supplied. A string must identify the schema/spec version, not merely be any string. Displaying unknown values is a product policy; a universal never-gate rule is not source-derived.

source_assertion_inventory.assertion: Implementation pointer and lack of actual reader performance/interop evidence
source_assertion_inventory.reason: The pointer section contains no implementation requirements or measured interop/performance results. Holding real tool interoperability unresolved is correct and is not an incompatibility finding. The source does contain an Implementations heading.

source_assertion_inventory.assertion: No tool names, versions, outputs or fixtures anywhere in S003
source_assertion_inventory.reason: bioformats2raw is named extensively, and skimage.transform.pyramid_gaussian plus version 0.16.1 are in the example. Lack of reader interoperability measurements is much narrower than this negative-check counterevidence assertion.

source_assertion_inventory.assertion: Literal-search results imply universal absence
source_assertion_inventory.evidence: complete S003:1-896; report and negative-check limits
source_assertion_inventory.reason: Scoping a search does not make a missed paraphrase/source restriction absent. Many narrow absence conclusions are corroborated by this independent full read; negative clauses with actual counterevidence remain false despite scope disclaimers.

source_assertion_inventory.assertion: Directory-scan prohibition replacement
source_assertion_inventory.reason: No explicit scanning prohibition is supplied; labeling it inference is accurate. Even inferred metadata authority does not forbid auxiliary scanning if the final identity/order remains validated.

source_assertion_inventory.assertion: Editorial duplicated wording at L93-L94
source_assertion_inventory.reason: Exact join is defined by / by the, not by the by the. R012 correction is accurate; R011 calls the wrong exact wording verified. No material format consequence.

source_assertion_inventory.assertion: Plan mapping KEEP/EXTEND/FLAG and optional capability review
source_assertion_inventory.reason: Core metadata/geometry/failure extensions fit the plan; interop FLAG is appropriate. Mandatory property legends/full pyramid metadata UI/particular fallback rendering overreach additional-capability review. Background responsiveness is required by the plan, not measured format implementation evidence.

source_assertion_inventory.assertion: Validation proposals V1-V9 are UNEXECUTED and appropriate
source_assertion_inventory.evidence: Viewer.md:5-11; S003 rules cited above; current report proposal lists
source_assertion_inventory.reason: All are current proposals, not test execution. Missing filesets/execution logs do not make the proposals false. Their seed-relative sameness/verbatim preservation cannot be established without excluded seed/history.

source_assertion_inventory.assertion: Original candidate U001-U012 comparison/dispositions/absence of false dismissals
source_assertion_inventory.evidence: current reports/verification JSON; excluded candidate seed not admitted
source_assertion_inventory.reason: Source substance can be checked now; exact matches, preservation, removed/added candidate content, and true absence of candidate false dismissals require the unadmitted seed/history. This is a missing-input condition, not proof the comparison claims are false.

source_assertion_inventory.assertion: Candidate acquisition reads/searches/denied attempts/no execution/native Goal/budgets/costs
source_assertion_inventory.evidence: current artifact assertions; acquisition/history not admitted
source_assertion_inventory.reason: The current report can label proposals unexecuted. Actual tool actions, budget compliance, exact tool inventory, no charges and no execution cannot be independently audited from normative S003. No runtime or economics inference is made.

source_assertion_inventory.assertion: Perfect coverage/support/no unsupported assertions/no invented obligations
source_assertion_inventory.evidence: adjudications S05,S38,S44,S65,S69,S70,S79; all six prospective facets
source_assertion_inventory.reason: The reports retain material source overstatements and omissions. Self-attested perfect support/full scope is not established by counting 12 units or 30 negative checks.

source_assertion_inventory.assertion: Source-line index ranges
source_assertion_inventory.reason: The semantic source section/range index resolves. This does not prove every conclusion cited to a broad range.

source_assertion_inventory.assertion: Numbers of dispositions/clarifications/additions/checks
source_assertion_inventory.evidence: actual final verification/check objects and report lists
source_assertion_inventory.reason: The JSON contains 12 seed-unit records; R011 10 supported plus 2 clarified, R012 7 qualified plus 5 confirmed, R012 30 negative records, 2 replacements, 4 additions, 4 non-findings. Other counts (e.g. eight SHOULD recommendations versus nine dot-separated groups) depend on undocumented grouping and are not evidence of semantic completeness.

facets.reason: Version/namespace admission and hierarchy consistency are explicit. Compatibility is bounded rather than legacy-reinterpreted.

Rank/order/name mapping and relevant controls are covered. Absent-versus-present singleton identity is not explicit; blanket untyped tolerance needs the 2/3-space constraint. R012 additionally classifies untyped axes by position rather than establishing metadata identity.
Declared group-relative metadata order and each level geometry govern selection, with missing/unsupported level feedback. No fixed numeric-folder or reduction assumption is used.

General composition/unknown units are covered, but no concrete nonzero-translation expectation tests reversed composition or omitted offsets. Valid UNEXECUTED proposals are credited, not treated as missing test execution. R012 F-29 notation scale∘translate conflicts with its scale-first prose.

Discovery, intermediate paths, count and transform checks are covered; declared relative source association is not made a prerequisite to overlay. R012 F-35 explicitly treats source.image as provenance only.

Integer/categorical/label-value and noninterpolating rendering ideas are present. Exact uint64/int64 identity preservation or a refused supported range is absent; palette recommendation force is not consistently preserved.
